content:
Fault code 21F0A3 indicates a high-voltage system malfunction resulting in reduced power/torque limitation; none of the supplied bulletins apply to the iX ME73 and no open recall is listed for this VIN. Proceed with ISTA diagnosis, reading the complete fault memory across the BMS, EME/PDH and related high-voltage control units, then follow the ISTA test plan for 21F0A3 including insulation-resistance and HV contactor checks. Verify the 12V battery and charging path given the June drain history, and record control-unit software versions before any component replacement.  
BMW Technical Support
